data.name: Dragon Blaze
data.detailed_description:
Pursuing the Ultimate Fun of Shooting Games

The 7th Installment of the Vertical-Scrolling Shooter Packed with New Features!

　

New System: “Dragon Shoot”!

Split your ship into two to drastically change your attack methods.

A refined game system and captivating worldview

offer enjoyment for everyone from shooting game beginners to hardcore fans.

　

Dora Bure!

　

However, this peaceful era came to an abrupt end

when the Demon King Neburos and his dark army suddenly appeared.

- Long ago,

during the Great War of the Gods at the world's creation, Neburos was defeated by the Sun and Moon Gods

and sealed away by four magic stones. Yet, a nation seeking victory

used the Demon King Summoning during the war, breaking the seal.

Having returned to the modern world,

Neburos seized the Moon God's spirit with dark power as vengeance.

The Moon God, who governs the composition of all things,

began transforming human minds and forms into hideous monstrosities one after another,

forging an army of darkness.

And all of Megalis

was drawn into a vortex of unprecedented destruction and chaos.

The dark forces had already begun moving against the Sun God.

Sensing this threat, the Sun God

entrusted the divine weapons to four Dragon Knights

and commanded them to defeat the Demon King Nebulos.

　

【8-way Lever】

Move your ship

　

【Shot】

Shot & Sub Shot

(Hold to perform Super Magic Attack during separation & combination) Separation Magic Combination Magic

　Firing shots at enemies fills the Magic Gauge.

When the gauge reaches a certain level, holding down the shot button fires a “Super Magic Attack”.

Each character has two types of Super Magic Attack, usable during Combination and after Dragon Shoot separation.

The two Super Magic Attacks differ in power, attack range, etc.

　

【Magic Bomb】

Emergency Evasion

Essentially a bomb. Effective range and strength vary by character.

　

【Dragon】 Dragon Shoot

Separation & Combination (Close-range Attack: Dragon Shoot)

Separates and combines the Rider and Dragon.

The instant they separate, the powerful close-range attack “Dragon Shoot” deals massive damage to any enemy it contacts.

　

Dragon Control

After separation, pressing the Dragon button again recalls the separated Dragon.

　Holding the Dragon Button during recall stops the dragon.

Use this to adjust the separated dragon's position.

　

Power-Up

Shots power up by one level.

Maximum power-up is three levels.

　

Magic Bomb

Increases Magic Bomb stock by one.

Maximum stock is nine.

　

Silver Coin

　A bonus item that appears when defeating enemies with shots, Super Magic Bombs, etc.

Each coin is worth 100 points.

　

Gold Coin

A bonus item that only appears when defeating enemies with Dragon Shots.

Each coin is worth 200 points.

Attack relentlessly, gold coins pour in!

　

Bonus Carry

Appears when performing a Dragon Shot at specific locations in each stage.

It's a Bonus Carry that spits out lots of gold coins.

　

Technical Bonus

Each stage boss has a weak point called the “Core,”

which is exposed only once during an attack.

Hitting it with a Dragon Shot allows you to quickly defeat the boss

and earn a “Technical Bonus.”

　

Achievement Rate

Your achievement rate is displayed when you get a Game Over.

It shows how far you progressed through the stage.

Sky-Riding Dragon Knight

Quade

　

Captain of the Royal Guard serving King Harad, ruler of the desert.

Returning from a foreign expedition, what he witnessed was a plundered, unrecognizable city and hordes of monsters flooding the land.

The curse of the Demon King Nebulos had transformed people worldwide into monsters.

His lover, Dina, was no exception.

“The Demon King! I just need to defeat that bastard!” Shaking off his subordinates' attempts to stop him, Quade charged forward.

　

● Age: 23

● Weapon: Lance (Mounted)

● Dragon: Fire Dragon

　

Shot: Fire Shot

Sub Shot: Holy Lance

Combination Magic: Burst Lance

Separation Magic: Fire Breath

Magic Bomb: Chaos Flare

　

The Girl of the Great Sea

Sonia

　

The only daughter of the Sea King. She constantly thinks about the safety and peace of the sea kingdom, Alje.

The Sea King's temple was destroyed by the Demon King's invasion, and the sea people, including the Queen (her mother), were turned into monsters.

Sonia, who escaped the curse within the barrier of the undersea temple, resolved to defeat the Demon King and lift the curse from the people.

“Mother, grant me power...!”

Sonia's journey begins to seize the four magic stones needed to defeat the Demon King.

　

● Age: 17

● Weapon: Longbow

● Dragon: Aqua Dragon

　

Shot: Bubble Shot

Subshot: Freeze Arrow

Combination Magic: Diamond Dust

Separation Magic: Aqua Blast

Magic Bomb: Trident Rush

Guardian of the Giant Tree Forest

Rob

　

Leader of the dwarves living happily in the hidden realm of Shaba.

Cheerful, fond of drink, and loves festivals. Stubborn and quick-tempered, yet deeply loved and trusted by all villagers.

Several years ago, when rumors of the Demon King's invasion began spreading, his brothers, with whom he had lived in harmony, vanished without a trace.

“Hmm... My brothers aren't here either...” Rob's journey of exploration continues.

　

● Age: 300 years old

● Weapon: Hammer

● Dragon: Thunder Dragon

　

Shot: Thunder Shot

Sub Shot: Plasma Hammer

Combination Magic: Lightning Hammer

Separation Magic: Giga Wave

Magic Bomb: Thunder Break

　

Young Necromancer

Ian

His birth and parents are unknown. Though Ian despised humans and lived in solitude, he opened his heart only to his master, who was also his foster father.

But then, the army led by Demon King Neburos attacked Maimana. Under the Demon King's curse, the townspeople were transformed into monsters.

“Ian...” A voice spoke to his thoughts as he stood frozen in shock. Before his eyes stood a single bone dragon.

In that instant, Ian understood everything. “Well then... shall we go, Master?”

Ian took flight and vanished into the mist.

　

● Age: 30

● Weapon: Magic Staff

● Dragon: Skull Dragon

　

Shot: Soul Shot

Sub Shot: Magic Sword

Combination Magic: Death Crash

Separation Magic: Health Pin

Magic Bomb: Dark Stinger
